m: Cook the brown rice: rinse, then simmer in plenty of water for 25 to 30 minutes like pasta, drain and steam with the lid on for 5 minutes.
Teriyaki: soy, mirin, honey and grated ginger. Pour half over the chicken and leave 10 minutes.
Pan-fry the chicken 5 to 6 minutes a side until cooked. Pour in the rest of the teriyaki for the last minute and let it glaze. Rest and slice.
Cook the edamame 3 minutes in boiling water. Ribbon the carrot and cucumber with a peeler and toss with the rice vinegar and a pinch of salt.
Build bowls: rice, chicken, edamame, pickled veg, avocado. Finish with spring onion, sesame and lime.
l: Made for lunch. Pack the avocado whole and slice on the day.
g: Tamari instead of soy in the teriyaki, cooked in a separate pan. Check the mirin.
